const (
	TeacherOnboardingEnsureSchema       = "teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionSchema      = "teacher-onboarding-session.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Schema    = "teacher-onboarding-session.v2"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema    = "teacher-onboarding-session.v3"
	TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1     = 1
	TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2     = 2
	AssistantUIActionSchema             = "assistant-ui-action.v1"
	AssistantUIActionResultSchema       = "assistant-ui-action-result.v1"
	AssistantUIActionResultV2Schema     = "assistant-ui-action-result.v2"
	AssistantUIEnvelopeSchema           = "assistant-ui.v1"
	DialogAssistantUISourceSchema       = "dialog-assistant-ui-source.v1"
	StudentOnboardingDraftSchema        = "student-onboarding-draft.v1"
	StudentOnboardingFinalizeSchema     = "student-onboarding-finalize.v1"
	StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult     = "student-onboarding-finalize-result.v1"
	TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema = "teacher-student-onboarding-state.v1"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding                      = errors.New("invalid teacher onboarding")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict                     = errors.New("teacher onboarding conflict")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy                         = errors.New("teacher onboarding action is in progress")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable                  = errors.New("teacher onboarding unavailable")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable = errors.New("historical_session_unavailable")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingTurnUnknown                  = errors.New("teacher onboarding turn unknown")
)

type StudentOnboardingDraftStatus string

const (
	StudentOnboardingDraftDraft     StudentOnboardingDraftStatus = "DRAFT"
	StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted StudentOnboardingDraftStatus = "COMPLETED"
)

type StudentOnboardingAnswers struct {
	DirectionCode          *string   `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience *string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            *[]string `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          *[]string `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               *string   `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalText               *string   `json:"goal_text"`
	PreferredLanguage      *string   `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          *int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          *string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
}

type StudentOnboardingDraft struct {
	Schema    string                       `json:"schema"`
	StudentID string                       `json:"student_id"`
	Status    StudentOnboardingDraftStatus `json:"status"`
	StudentOnboardingAnswers
	Version                 int64      `json:"version"`
	CompletedProfileVersion *int64     `json:"completed_profile_version,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt               *time.Time `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt               *time.Time `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
	CompletedAt             *time.Time `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherStudentOnboardingState struct {
	Schema         string                 `json:"schema"`
	Draft          StudentOnboardingDraft `json:"draft"`
	ProfileVersion int64                  `json:"profile_version"`
}

type StudentOnboardingProfile struct {
	StudentID              string    `json:"student_id"`
	DirectionCode          string    `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string    `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string  `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string  `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string    `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalText               string    `json:"goal_text,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage      string    `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int       `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string    `json:"preferred_pace"`
	ProfileVersion         string    `json:"profile_version"`
	Version                int64     `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt              time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse struct {
	Schema  string                   `json:"schema"`
	Draft   StudentOnboardingDraft   `json:"draft"`
	Profile StudentOnboardingProfile `json:"profile"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(input TeacherStudentOnboardingState, studentID string) (TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if input.Schema != TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema || !validUUID(studentID) || input.ProfileVersion < 0 {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	draft, err := normalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(input.Draft, studentID)
	if err != nil || (draft.Status == StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted &&
		(draft.CompletedProfileVersion == nil || input.ProfileVersion < *draft.CompletedProfileVersion)) {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.Draft = draft
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(input StudentOnboardingDraft, studentID string) (StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	if input.Schema != StudentOnboardingDraftSchema || input.StudentID != studentID || input.Version < 0 {
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.CreatedAt = onboardingUTC(input.CreatedAt)
	input.UpdatedAt = onboardingUTC(input.UpdatedAt)
	input.CompletedAt = onboardingUTC(input.CompletedAt)
	if input.Version == 0 {
		if input.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftDraft || hasOnboardingAnswers(input.StudentOnboardingAnswers) ||
			input.CreatedAt != nil || input.UpdatedAt != nil || input.CompletedAt != nil || input.CompletedProfileVersion != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		return input, nil
	}
	if input.CreatedAt == nil || input.UpdatedAt == nil || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(*input.CreatedAt) {
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch input.Status {
	case StudentOnboardingDraftDraft:
		if input.CompletedAt != nil || input.CompletedProfileVersion != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted:
		if hasOnboardingAnswers(input.StudentOnboardingAnswers) || input.CompletedAt == nil ||
			input.CompletedProfileVersion == nil || *input.CompletedProfileVersion < 1 || input.CompletedAt.Before(*input.CreatedAt) || input.CompletedAt.After(*input.UpdatedAt) {
			return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func onboardingUTC(value *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if value == nil {
		return nil
	}
	result := value.UTC()
	return &result
}

func hasOnboardingAnswers(input StudentOnboardingAnswers) bool {
	return input.DirectionCode != nil || input.SelfAssessedExperience != nil || input.KnownStacks != nil ||
		input.DesiredStacks != nil || input.GoalCode != nil || input.GoalText != nil ||
		input.PreferredLanguage != nil || input.WeeklyMinutes != nil || input.PreferredPace != nil
}

type TeacherOnboardingStep string

const (
	OnboardingStepDirection     TeacherOnboardingStep = "direction"
	OnboardingStepExperience    TeacherOnboardingStep = "experience"
	OnboardingStepKnownStack    TeacherOnboardingStep = "known_stack"
	OnboardingStepDesiredStack  TeacherOnboardingStep = "desired_stack"
	OnboardingStepGoal          TeacherOnboardingStep = "goal"
	OnboardingStepLanguage      TeacherOnboardingStep = "language"
	OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes TeacherOnboardingStep = "weekly_minutes"
	OnboardingStepPace          TeacherOnboardingStep = "pace"
	OnboardingStepConfirmation  TeacherOnboardingStep = "confirmation"
	OnboardingStepComplete      TeacherOnboardingStep = "complete"
)

type onboardingChoice struct {
	ActionID, Value, LabelRU, LabelEN string
	Minutes                           int
}

// productAwareOnboardingChoices is immutable prompt policy v2. It does not
// modify v1 replay values. Optional planning inputs (known stacks, weekly
// minutes, pace and interests) are intentionally absent; desired stack is
// exposed only for the currently supported Go backend specialization.
var productAwareOnboardingChoices = map[TeacherOnboardingStep][]onboardingChoice{
	OnboardingStepGoal: {
		{"goal.learn_programming", "learn_programming", "Научиться программировать", "Learn programming", 0},
	},
	OnboardingStepExperience: {
		{"experience.beginner", "beginner", "Начинаю с нуля", "Starting from scratch", 0},
		{"experience.basic", "basic", "Знаю основы", "Know the basics", 0},
		{"experience.intermediate", "intermediate", "Есть практика", "Have practical experience", 0},
		{"experience.advanced", "advanced", "Опытный", "Advanced", 0},
	},
	OnboardingStepDirection: {
		{"direction.undecided", "undecided", "Не знаю", "Not sure yet", 0},
		{"direction.backend", "backend", "Backend", "Backend", 0},
		{"direction.frontend", "frontend", "Frontend", "Frontend", 0},
		{"direction.fullstack", "fullstack", "Fullstack", "Full stack", 0},
		{"direction.data", "data", "Данные", "Data", 0},
	},
	OnboardingStepDesiredStack: {
		{"desired.go", "go", "Go для backend", "Go for backend", 0},
	},
	OnboardingStepLanguage: {
		{"language.ru", "ru", "Русский", "Russian", 0},
		{"language.en", "en", "Английский", "English", 0},
	},
	OnboardingStepConfirmation: onboardingChoices[OnboardingStepConfirmation],
}

func NextTeacherOnboardingStep(draft StudentOnboardingDraft) (TeacherOnboardingStep, error) {
	if draft.Status == StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted {
		return OnboardingStepComplete, nil
	}
	if draft.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftDraft {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	for _, step := range []TeacherOnboardingStep{OnboardingStepDirection, OnboardingStepExperience, OnboardingStepKnownStack, OnboardingStepDesiredStack, OnboardingStepGoal, OnboardingStepLanguage, OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes, OnboardingStepPace} {
		if draftAnswerPresent(draft, step) && !draftAnswerAllowed(draft, step) {
			return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	}
	checks := []struct {
		step     TeacherOnboardingStep
		answered bool
	}{
		{OnboardingStepDirection, draft.DirectionCode != nil}, {OnboardingStepExperience, draft.SelfAssessedExperience != nil},
		{OnboardingStepKnownStack, draft.KnownStacks != nil}, {OnboardingStepDesiredStack, draft.DesiredStacks != nil},
		{OnboardingStepGoal, draft.GoalCode != nil}, {OnboardingStepLanguage, draft.PreferredLanguage != nil},
		{OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes, draft.WeeklyMinutes != nil}, {OnboardingStepPace, draft.PreferredPace != nil},
	}
	for _, check := range checks {
		if !check.answered {
			return check.step, validateAnsweredOnboarding(draft, check.step)
		}
	}
	if err := validateAnsweredOnboarding(draft, OnboardingStepConfirmation); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return OnboardingStepConfirmation, nil
}

func draftAnswerPresent(draft StudentOnboardingDraft, step TeacherOnboardingStep) bool {
	switch step {
	case OnboardingStepDirection:
		return draft.DirectionCode != nil
	case OnboardingStepExperience:
		return draft.SelfAssessedExperience != nil
	case OnboardingStepKnownStack:
		return draft.KnownStacks != nil
	case OnboardingStepDesiredStack:
		return draft.DesiredStacks != nil
	case OnboardingStepGoal:
		return draft.GoalCode != nil
	case OnboardingStepLanguage:
		return draft.PreferredLanguage != nil
	case OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes:
		return draft.WeeklyMinutes != nil
	case OnboardingStepPace:
		return draft.PreferredPace != nil
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validateAnsweredOnboarding(draft StudentOnboardingDraft, until TeacherOnboardingStep) error {
	order := []TeacherOnboardingStep{OnboardingStepDirection, OnboardingStepExperience, OnboardingStepKnownStack, OnboardingStepDesiredStack, OnboardingStepGoal, OnboardingStepLanguage, OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes, OnboardingStepPace}
	for _, step := range order {
		if step == until {
			return nil
		}
		if !draftAnswerAllowed(draft, step) {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func draftAnswerAllowed(draft StudentOnboardingDraft, step TeacherOnboardingStep) bool {
	var value string
	switch step {
	case OnboardingStepDirection:
		if draft.DirectionCode == nil {
			return false
		}
		value = *draft.DirectionCode
	case OnboardingStepExperience:
		if draft.SelfAssessedExperience == nil {
			return false
		}
		value = *draft.SelfAssessedExperience
	case OnboardingStepKnownStack:
		if draft.KnownStacks == nil || len(*draft.KnownStacks) > 1 {
			return false
		}
		if len(*draft.KnownStacks) == 0 {
			value = ""
		} else {
			value = (*draft.KnownStacks)[0]
		}
	case OnboardingStepDesiredStack:
		if draft.DesiredStacks == nil || len(*draft.DesiredStacks) != 1 {
			return false
		}
		value = (*draft.DesiredStacks)[0]
	case OnboardingStepGoal:
		if draft.GoalCode == nil {
			return false
		}
		value = *draft.GoalCode
	case OnboardingStepLanguage:
		if draft.PreferredLanguage == nil {
			return false
		}
		value = *draft.PreferredLanguage
	case OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes:
		if draft.WeeklyMinutes == nil {
			return false
		}
		for _, choice := range onboardingChoices[step] {
			if choice.Minutes == *draft.WeeklyMinutes {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	case OnboardingStepPace:
		if draft.PreferredPace == nil {
			return false
		}
		value = *draft.PreferredPace
	}
	for _, choice := range onboardingChoices[step] {
		if choice.Value == value {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type AssistantUIOption struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Label string `json:"label"`
}
type AssistantUIChoiceData struct {
	Prompt  string              `json:"prompt"`
	Options []AssistantUIOption `json:"options"`
}
type AssistantUIConfirmationData struct {
	Title       string            `json:"title"`
	Description string            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Confirm     AssistantUIOption `json:"confirm"`
}
type AssistantUIBlock struct {
	ID           string                       `json:"id"`
	Version      int                          `json:"version"`
	Type         string                       `json:"type"`
	Choice       *AssistantUIChoiceData       `json:"-"`
	Confirmation *AssistantUIConfirmationData `json:"-"`
}

func (block AssistantUIBlock) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	data := any(block.Choice)
	if block.Type == "confirmation" {
		data = block.Confirmation
	}
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		ID      string `json:"id"`
		Version int    `json:"version"`
		Type    string `json:"type"`
		Data    any    `json:"data"`
	}{block.ID, block.Version, block.Type, data})
}

type AssistantUIEnvelope struct {
	Schema string             `json:"schema"`
	Blocks []AssistantUIBlock `json:"blocks"`
}

func OnboardingLocale(draft StudentOnboardingDraft) string {
	if draft.PreferredLanguage != nil && *draft.PreferredLanguage == "en" {
		return "en"
	}
	return "ru"
}

func BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step TeacherOnboardingStep, locale string, draftVersions ...int64) (string, json.RawMessage, error) {
	return buildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, locale, TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1, draftVersions...)
}

func BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step TeacherOnboardingStep, locale string, draftVersions ...int64) (string, json.RawMessage, error) {
	return buildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, locale, TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2, draftVersions...)
}

func buildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step TeacherOnboardingStep, locale string, policyVersion int, draftVersions ...int64) (string, json.RawMessage, error) {
	if step == OnboardingStepComplete {
		if policyVersion != TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1 {
			return "", nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		return completionBody(locale), nil, nil
	}
	draftVersion := int64(0)
	if len(draftVersions) > 1 || (len(draftVersions) == 1 && draftVersions[0] < 0) {
		return "", nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if len(draftVersions) == 1 {
		draftVersion = draftVersions[0]
	}
	choices, ok := onboardingChoicesForPolicy(step, policyVersion)
	if !ok || len(choices) == 0 {
		return "", nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	promptRU := map[TeacherOnboardingStep]string{OnboardingStepDirection: "Какое направление вам интереснее?", OnboardingStepExperience: "Как вы оцениваете свой текущий опыт?", OnboardingStepKnownStack: "Какой основной стек вы уже знаете?", OnboardingStepDesiredStack: "Хотите изучать Go для backend?", OnboardingStepGoal: "Какова ваша главная цель?", OnboardingStepLanguage: "На каком языке вести обучение?", OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes: "Сколько времени в неделю вы готовы заниматься?", OnboardingStepPace: "Какой темп вам подходит?", OnboardingStepConfirmation: "Подтвердите ответы"}
	promptEN := map[TeacherOnboardingStep]string{OnboardingStepDirection: "Which direction interests you most?", OnboardingStepExperience: "How would you describe your current experience?", OnboardingStepKnownStack: "Which main stack do you already know?", OnboardingStepDesiredStack: "Would you like to learn Go for backend development?", OnboardingStepGoal: "What is your main goal?", OnboardingStepLanguage: "Which language should I use for the learning content?", OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes: "How much time can you study each week?", OnboardingStepPace: "Which pace suits you?", OnboardingStepConfirmation: "Confirm your answers"}
	prompt := promptRU[step]
	if policyVersion == TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 && step == OnboardingStepLanguage {
		prompt = "На каком языке показывать учебные материалы?"
	}
	if locale == "en" {
		prompt = promptEN[step]
	}
	options := make([]AssistantUIOption, len(choices))
	for index, choice := range choices {
		label := choice.LabelRU
		if locale == "en" {
			label = choice.LabelEN
		}
		options[index] = AssistantUIOption{choice.ActionID, label}
	}
	block := AssistantUIBlock{ID: "onboarding." + string(step) + ".d" + strconv.FormatInt(draftVersion, 10) + ".v" + strconv.Itoa(policyVersion), Version: 1, Type: "choice", Choice: &AssistantUIChoiceData{Prompt: prompt, Options: options}}
	if step == OnboardingStepConfirmation {
		block.Type = "confirmation"
		block.Choice = nil
		block.Confirmation = &AssistantUIConfirmationData{Title: prompt, Description: confirmationDescription(locale), Confirm: options[0]}
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(AssistantUIEnvelope{Schema: AssistantUIEnvelopeSchema, Blocks: []AssistantUIBlock{block}})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > 64<<10 {
		return "", nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return prompt, payload, nil
}

func completionBody(locale string) string {
	if locale == "en" {
		return "Onboarding is complete. I’ll use these preferences to guide our work."
	}
	return "Онбординг завершён. Я буду учитывать эти предпочтения в нашей работе."
}
func confirmationDescription(locale string) string {
	if locale == "en" {
		return "Confirm and save this answer."
	}
	return "Подтвердить и сохранить этот ответ."
}

func ApplyTeacherOnboardingAction(draft StudentOnboardingDraft, step TeacherOnboardingStep, actionID string) (StudentOnboardingAnswers, bool, error) {
	choice, ok := onboardingChoiceFor(step, actionID)
	if !ok {
		return StudentOnboardingAnswers{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	answers := cloneOnboardingAnswers(draft.StudentOnboardingAnswers)
	switch step {
	case OnboardingStepDirection:
		answers.DirectionCode = stringPointer(choice.Value)
	case OnboardingStepExperience:
		answers.SelfAssessedExperience = stringPointer(choice.Value)
	case OnboardingStepKnownStack:
		values := []string{}
		if choice.Value != "" {
			values = []string{choice.Value}
		}
		answers.KnownStacks = &values
	case OnboardingStepDesiredStack:
		values := []string{choice.Value}
		answers.DesiredStacks = &values
	case OnboardingStepGoal:
		answers.GoalCode = stringPointer(choice.Value)
	case OnboardingStepLanguage:
		answers.PreferredLanguage = stringPointer(choice.Value)
	case OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes:
		value := choice.Minutes
		answers.WeeklyMinutes = &value
	case OnboardingStepPace:
		answers.PreferredPace = stringPointer(choice.Value)
	case OnboardingStepConfirmation:
		return answers, true, nil
	default:
		return StudentOnboardingAnswers{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return answers, false, nil
}

func onboardingChoiceFor(step TeacherOnboardingStep, actionID string) (onboardingChoice, bool) {
	for _, choice := range onboardingChoices[step] {
		if choice.ActionID == actionID {
			return choice, true
		}
	}
	return onboardingChoice{}, false
}

func onboardingChoicesForPolicy(step TeacherOnboardingStep, policyVersion int) ([]onboardingChoice, bool) {
	var source map[TeacherOnboardingStep][]onboardingChoice
	switch policyVersion {
	case TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1:
		source = onboardingChoices
	case TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2:
		source = productAwareOnboardingChoices
	default:
		return nil, false
	}
	choices, ok := source[step]
	return choices, ok
}

func onboardingChoiceForPolicy(step TeacherOnboardingStep, actionID string, policyVersion int) (onboardingChoice, bool) {
	choices, ok := onboardingChoicesForPolicy(step, policyVersion)
	if !ok {
		return onboardingChoice{}, false
	}
	for _, choice := range choices {
		if choice.ActionID == actionID {
			return choice, true
		}
	}
	return onboardingChoice{}, false
}

func cloneOnboardingAnswers(input StudentOnboardingAnswers) StudentOnboardingAnswers {
	result := input
	if input.KnownStacks != nil {
		values := append([]string{}, (*input.KnownStacks)...)
		result.KnownStacks = &values
	}
	if input.DesiredStacks != nil {
		values := append([]string{}, (*input.DesiredStacks)...)
		result.DesiredStacks = &values
	}
	return result
}
func stringPointer(value string) *string { return &value }

type DialogAssistantUISource struct {
	Schema            string          `json:"schema"`
	DialogID          string          `json:"dialog_id"`
	StudentID         string          `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID string          `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ContextType       string          `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID         *string         `json:"context_id,omitempty"`
	MessageID         string          `json:"message_id"`
	MessageSequence   int64           `json:"message_sequence"`
	MessageVersion    int             `json:"message_version"`
	AssistantUI       json.RawMessage `json:"assistant_ui"`
}

func ValidateOnboardingAssistantUISource(source DialogAssistantUISource, binding TeacherDialogBinding, expectedMessageID string, expectedVersion int, step TeacherOnboardingStep, actionID, locale string, draftVersion int64) error {
	policyVersion, err := TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(source.AssistantUI)
	if err != nil {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if err := ValidateCurrentOnboardingAssistantUISource(source, binding, expectedMessageID, expectedVersion, step, locale, draftVersion); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := onboardingChoiceForPolicy(step, actionID, policyVersion); !ok {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidateCurrentOnboardingAssistantUISource verifies that a persisted Dialog
// message is the exact current deterministic prompt. Unlike action validation,
// it deliberately does not require a selected option: Ensure only needs to
// recover the current prompt identity, never resolve a browser action.
func ValidateCurrentOnboardingAssistantUISource(source DialogAssistantUISource, binding TeacherDialogBinding, expectedMessageID string, expectedVersion int, step TeacherOnboardingStep, locale string, draftVersion int64) error {
	if source.Schema != DialogAssistantUISourceSchema || source.DialogID != binding.ID || source.StudentID != binding.StudentID || source.PersonalTeacherID != binding.PersonalTeacherID ||
		source.ContextType != "general_teacher" || source.ContextID != nil || source.MessageID != expectedMessageID || expectedVersion < 1 || source.MessageVersion != expectedVersion || source.MessageSequence < 1 {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	policyVersion, err := TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(source.AssistantUI)
	if err != nil {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	_, expected, err := buildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, locale, policyVersion, draftVersion)
	if err != nil || len(expected) == 0 {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if !equivalentStrictAssistantUI(expected, source.AssistantUI) {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return nil
}

// CurrentOnboardingPromptCommandID is shared by Ensure and delivery after an
// action. The identity is scoped to the exact Dialog and Student-owned state,
// so a concurrent Ensure and action delivery resolve to the same Dialog append
// rather than content-deduplicating unrelated messages.
func CurrentOnboardingPromptCommandID(binding TeacherDialogBinding, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, step TeacherOnboardingStep, promptPolicyVersions ...int) (string, error) {
	normalized, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	policyVersion := TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1
	if len(promptPolicyVersions) > 1 || (len(promptPolicyVersions) == 1 && promptPolicyVersions[0] != TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1 && promptPolicyVersions[0] != TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2) {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if len(promptPolicyVersions) == 1 {
		policyVersion = promptPolicyVersions[0]
	}
	if err != nil || normalized.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral || draftVersion < 0 || profileVersion < 0 {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if _, ok := onboardingChoicesForPolicy(step, policyVersion); !ok || step == OnboardingStepComplete {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if policyVersion == TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 {
		return DeterministicOnboardingUUID("ensure-v2", normalized.ID, draftVersion, profileVersion, step), nil
	}
	return DeterministicOnboardingUUID("ensure", normalized.ID, draftVersion, profileVersion, step), nil
}

// TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion reads the immutable policy suffix from
// one exact assistant-ui block. Assistant UI's own block version remains v1;
// the onboarding policy version is carried only by the server-owned block ID.
func TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(raw json.RawMessage) (int, error) {
	envelope, err := strictAssistantUI(raw)
	if err != nil || len(envelope.Blocks) != 1 {
		return 0, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	_, policyVersion, _, ok := onboardingBlockIdentity(envelope.Blocks[0].ID)
	if !ok {
		return 0, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return policyVersion, nil
}

func TeacherOnboardingPromptStep(raw json.RawMessage) (TeacherOnboardingStep, int, error) {
	envelope, err := strictAssistantUI(raw)
	if err != nil || len(envelope.Blocks) != 1 {
		return "", 0, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	step, policyVersion, _, ok := onboardingBlockIdentity(envelope.Blocks[0].ID)
	if !ok {
		return "", 0, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return step, policyVersion, nil
}

func ResolveOnboardingAssistantUISourceLocale(source DialogAssistantUISource, binding TeacherDialogBinding, expectedMessageID string, expectedVersion int, step TeacherOnboardingStep, actionID string, draftVersion int64) (string, error) {
	for _, locale := range []string{"ru", "en"} {
		if ValidateOnboardingAssistantUISource(source, binding, expectedMessageID, expectedVersion, step, actionID, locale, draftVersion) == nil {
			return locale, nil
		}
	}
	return "", ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}

type strictAssistantUIEnvelope struct {
	Schema string                   `json:"schema"`
	Blocks []strictAssistantUIBlock `json:"blocks"`
}
type strictAssistantUIBlock struct {
	ID      string          `json:"id"`
	Version int             `json:"version"`
	Type    string          `json:"type"`
	Data    json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
}
type strictChoiceData struct {
	Prompt  string              `json:"prompt"`
	Options []AssistantUIOption `json:"options"`
}
type strictConfirmationData struct {
	Title       string            `json:"title"`
	Description string            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Confirm     AssistantUIOption `json:"confirm"`
}

func strictAssistantUI(raw json.RawMessage) (strictAssistantUIEnvelope, error) {
	var envelope strictAssistantUIEnvelope
	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > 64<<10 || strictJSON(raw, &envelope) != nil || envelope.Schema != AssistantUIEnvelopeSchema || len(envelope.Blocks) != 1 {
		return strictAssistantUIEnvelope{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	block := envelope.Blocks[0]
	if block.Version != 1 || block.ID == "" {
		return strictAssistantUIEnvelope{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch block.Type {
	case "choice":
		var data strictChoiceData
		if strictJSON(block.Data, &data) != nil || data.Prompt == "" || len(data.Options) == 0 || len(data.Options) > 20 || !validAssistantOptions(data.Options) {
			return strictAssistantUIEnvelope{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case "confirmation":
		var data strictConfirmationData
		if strictJSON(block.Data, &data) != nil || data.Title == "" || data.Confirm.ID == "" || data.Confirm.Label == "" {
			return strictAssistantUIEnvelope{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return strictAssistantUIEnvelope{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return envelope, nil
}

func equivalentStrictAssistantUI(wantRaw, gotRaw json.RawMessage) bool {
	if _, err := strictAssistantUI(wantRaw); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if _, err := strictAssistantUI(gotRaw); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	var want, got any
	if json.Unmarshal(wantRaw, &want) != nil || json.Unmarshal(gotRaw, &got) != nil {
		return false
	}
	return reflect.DeepEqual(want, got)
}

func validAssistantOptions(options []AssistantUIOption) bool {
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, option := range options {
		if option.ID == "" || option.Label == "" {
			return false
		}
		if _, ok := seen[option.ID]; ok {
			return false
		}
		seen[option.ID] = struct{}{}
	}
	return true
}
func strictJSON(raw []byte, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("trailing JSON")
	}
	return nil
}

type AssistantUIActionRequest struct {
	Schema         string `json:"schema"`
	DialogID       string `json:"dialog_id"`
	MessageID      string `json:"message_id"`
	MessageVersion int    `json:"message_version"`
	BlockID        string `json:"block_id"`
	ActionID       string `json:"action_id"`
	IdempotencyKey string `json:"idempotency_key"`
}

func NormalizeAssistantUIActionRequest(input AssistantUIActionRequest) (AssistantUIActionRequest, error) {
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.MessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.MessageID)
	input.BlockID = strings.TrimSpace(input.BlockID)
	input.ActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	if input.Schema != AssistantUIActionSchema || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.MessageID) || !validUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || input.MessageVersion < 1 || !validOnboardingOpaqueID(input.BlockID) || !validOnboardingOpaqueID(input.ActionID) {
		return AssistantUIActionRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}
func validOnboardingOpaqueID(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if (r < 'a' || r > 'z') && (r < '0' || r > '9') && r != '.' && r != '_' && r != '-' && r != ':' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type TeacherOnboardingSession struct {
	Schema         string                       `json:"schema"`
	DialogID       string                       `json:"dialog_id"`
	MessageID      *string                      `json:"message_id"`
	MessageVersion *int                         `json:"message_version"`
	Status         StudentOnboardingDraftStatus `json:"status"`
	DraftVersion   int64                        `json:"draft_version"`
	ProfileVersion int64                        `json:"profile_version"`
	V2             *TeacherOnboardingSessionV2  `json:"-"`
	V3             *TeacherOnboardingSessionV3  `json:"-"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status string
type TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase string

type TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status string

type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerStatus string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting       TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status = "COLLECTING"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffPending     TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status = "HANDOFF_PENDING"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted    TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status = "PLANNER_HANDOFF_ACCEPTED"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"
)

const (
	TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind = "ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME"

	TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady        TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerStatus = "PATH_READY"
	TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerActiveExists TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerStatus = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"
)

const (
	TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting       TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status = "COLLECTING"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady    TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status = "PLANNING_READY"
	TeacherOnboardingSessionActivePathExists TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"

	TeacherOnboardingPhaseGettingAcquainted TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase = "GETTING_ACQUAINTED"
	TeacherOnboardingPhaseDeterminingStart  TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase = "DETERMINING_START"
	TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath     TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase = "PREPARING_PATH"
	TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart      TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase = "READY_TO_START"
)

type TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt struct {
	MessageID      string `json:"message_id"`
	MessageVersion int    `json:"message_version"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingTerminal struct {
	Kind        TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status `json:"kind"`
	DisplayName string                           `json:"display_name,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSessionV2 struct {
	Schema        string                           `json:"schema"`
	DialogID      string                           `json:"dialog_id"`
	Status        TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Status `json:"status"`
	Phase         TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase  `json:"phase"`
	StateRef      TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef  `json:"state_ref"`
	CurrentPrompt *TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt  `json:"current_prompt,omitempty"`
	Terminal      *TeacherOnboardingTerminal       `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3 struct {
	Kind            TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status `json:"kind"`
	DisplayName     string                           `json:"display_name,omitempty"`
	ExecutionStatus string                           `json:"execution_status,omitempty"`
	ContentStatus   string                           `json:"content_status,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSessionV3 struct {
	Schema        string                              `json:"schema"`
	DialogID      string                              `json:"dialog_id"`
	Status        TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status    `json:"status"`
	Phase         TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase     `json:"phase"`
	StateRef      TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef     `json:"state_ref"`
	CurrentPrompt *TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt     `json:"current_prompt,omitempty"`
	Terminal      *TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3        `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
	PathOutcome   *TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker `json:"path_outcome,omitempty"`
}

// TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker is the only S9 delivery fact exposed to
// the browser. It deliberately omits Planner, handoff, execution, course,
// path, and lesson identities; Dialog message identity is the REST
// reconciliation fence used by the frontend before any owner hydration.
type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker struct {
	Kind            string                                   `json:"kind"`
	Status          TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerStatus `json:"status"`
	DialogMessageID string                                   `json:"dialog_message_id"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker(input TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker) (TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker, error) {
	input.Kind = strings.TrimSpace(input.Kind)
	input.DialogMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogMessageID)
	if input.Kind != TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind || !validUUID(input.DialogMessageID) {
		return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady, TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerActiveExists:
		return input, nil
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
}

func DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(payload TeacherOnboardingSessionV3) (TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSessionV3(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	return TeacherOnboardingSession{V3: &normalized}, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSessionV3(input TeacherOnboardingSessionV3) (TeacherOnboardingSessionV3, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	stateRef, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef)
	if err != nil || input.Schema != TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema || !validUUID(input.DialogID) {
		return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.StateRef = stateRef
	if input.PathOutcome != nil {
		marker, markerErr := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker(*input.PathOutcome)
		if markerErr != nil {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, markerErr
		}
		input.PathOutcome = &marker
	}
	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseGettingAcquainted && input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseDeterminingStart && input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		if input.CurrentPrompt == nil || input.Terminal != nil || input.PathOutcome != nil || !validUUID(input.CurrentPrompt.MessageID) || input.CurrentPrompt.MessageVersion < 1 {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffPending:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath || input.CurrentPrompt != nil || input.PathOutcome != nil || input.Terminal == nil || input.Terminal.Kind != input.Status ||
			(input.Terminal.DisplayName != TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName && input.Terminal.DisplayName != TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName) ||
			input.Terminal.ExecutionStatus != "" || input.Terminal.ContentStatus != TeacherLearningContentNotCreated {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart || input.CurrentPrompt != nil || input.Terminal == nil || input.Terminal.Kind != input.Status ||
			(input.Terminal.DisplayName != TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName && input.Terminal.DisplayName != TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName) ||
			input.Terminal.ExecutionStatus != TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted || input.Terminal.ContentStatus != TeacherLearningContentNotCreated {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart || input.CurrentPrompt != nil || input.Terminal == nil || input.Terminal.Kind != input.Status ||
			input.Terminal.DisplayName != "" || input.Terminal.ExecutionStatus != "" || input.Terminal.ContentStatus != "" {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func ProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSession(payload TeacherOnboardingSessionV2) (TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSessionV2(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	return TeacherOnboardingSession{V2: &normalized}, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSessionV2(input TeacherOnboardingSessionV2) (TeacherOnboardingSessionV2, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	stateRef, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef)
	if err != nil || input.Schema != TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Schema || !validUUID(input.DialogID) {
		return TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.StateRef = stateRef
	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseGettingAcquainted && input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseDeterminingStart && input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		if input.CurrentPrompt == nil || input.Terminal != nil || !validUUID(input.CurrentPrompt.MessageID) || input.CurrentPrompt.MessageVersion < 1 {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart || input.CurrentPrompt != nil || input.Terminal == nil || input.Terminal.Kind != input.Status ||
			(input.Terminal.DisplayName != TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName && input.Terminal.DisplayName != TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName) {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSessionActivePathExists:
		if input.Phase != TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart || input.CurrentPrompt != nil || input.Terminal == nil || input.Terminal.Kind != input.Status || input.Terminal.DisplayName != "" {
			return TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func (session TeacherOnboardingSession) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if session.V3 != nil {
		normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSessionV3(*session.V3)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return json.Marshal(normalized)
	}
	if session.V2 != nil {
		normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSessionV2(*session.V2)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return json.Marshal(normalized)
	}
	type legacyTeacherOnboardingSession TeacherOnboardingSession
	legacy := legacyTeacherOnboardingSession(session)
	legacy.V2 = nil
	legacy.V3 = nil
	return json.Marshal(legacy)
}

type AssistantUIActionResultPayload struct {
	Schema         string                       `json:"schema"`
	Applied        bool                         `json:"applied"`
	Replayed       bool                         `json:"replayed"`
	Status         StudentOnboardingDraftStatus `json:"status"`
	DraftVersion   int64                        `json:"draft_version"`
	ProfileVersion int64                        `json:"profile_version"`
	NextMessageID  *string                      `json:"next_message_id"`
}

// AssistantUIActionResult preserves v1 for legacy callers and serializes the
// dark canonical branch as its separate strict v2 contract.
type AssistantUIActionResult struct {
	AssistantUIActionResultPayload
	V2 *AssistantUIActionResultV2Payload
}

type AssistantUIActionResultV2Payload struct {
	Schema                    string `json:"schema"`
	Mode                      string `json:"mode"`
	Materialized              bool   `json:"materialized"`
	Replayed                  bool   `json:"replayed"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
}

func LegacyAssistantUIActionResult(payload AssistantUIActionResultPayload) AssistantUIActionResult {
	return AssistantUIActionResult{AssistantUIActionResultPayload: payload}
}

func (result AssistantUIActionResult) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if result.V2 != nil {
		return json.Marshal(result.V2)
	}
	return json.Marshal(result.AssistantUIActionResultPayload)
}

type OnboardingActionReceiptStatus string

const (
	OnboardingReceiptClaimed      OnboardingActionReceiptStatus = "claimed"
	OnboardingReceiptApplied      OnboardingActionReceiptStatus = "applied"
	OnboardingReceiptCompleted    OnboardingActionReceiptStatus = "completed"
	OnboardingReceiptRejected     OnboardingActionReceiptStatus = "rejected"
	OnboardingReceiptMaterialized OnboardingActionReceiptStatus = "materialized"
)

type OnboardingActionExecutionMode string

const (
	OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy    OnboardingActionExecutionMode = "legacy"
	OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical OnboardingActionExecutionMode = "canonical"
)

type OnboardingActionReceipt struct {
	IdempotencyKey            string
	RequestHash               string
	StudentID                 string
	PersonalTeacherID         string
	DialogID                  string
	SourceMessageID           string
	SourceMessageVersion      int
	BlockID                   string
	ActionID                  string
	Step                      TeacherOnboardingStep
	Status                    OnboardingActionReceiptStatus
	ExecutionMode             OnboardingActionExecutionMode
	ClaimToken                string
	LockedUntil               *time.Time
	ExpectedDraftVersion      *int64
	ExpectedProfileVersion    *int64
	ResultDraftVersion        *int64
	ResultProfileVersion      *int64
	ResultStatus              StudentOnboardingDraftStatus
	StudentCommandID          string
	DialogMessageCommandID    string
	CanonicalMessageCommandID string
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string
	NextMessageID             string
	CreatedAt                 time.Time
	UpdatedAt                 time.Time
	CompletedAt               *time.Time
}

func NewOnboardingActionReceipt(request AssistantUIActionRequest, studentID, teacherID, claimToken string, now, lockedUntil time.Time) (OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	return NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(request, studentID, teacherID, claimToken, now, lockedUntil, OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy)
}

func NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(request AssistantUIActionRequest, studentID, teacherID, claimToken string, now, lockedUntil time.Time, mode OnboardingActionExecutionMode) (OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	request, err := NormalizeAssistantUIActionRequest(request)
	if err != nil || !validUUID(studentID) || !validUUID(teacherID) || !validUUID(claimToken) || now.IsZero() || !lockedUntil.After(now) {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	hash, err := onboardingActionHash(request)
	if err != nil {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, err
	}
	step := stepFromBlockID(request.BlockID)
	if step == "" {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	now = now.UTC()
	lockedUntil = lockedUntil.UTC()
	if mode != OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy && mode != OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	receipt := OnboardingActionReceipt{IdempotencyKey: request.IdempotencyKey, RequestHash: hash, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, DialogID: request.DialogID, SourceMessageID: request.MessageID, SourceMessageVersion: request.MessageVersion, BlockID: request.BlockID, ActionID: request.ActionID, Step: step, Status: OnboardingReceiptClaimed, ExecutionMode: mode, ClaimToken: claimToken, LockedUntil: &lockedUntil, StudentCommandID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("student", request.IdempotencyKey), DialogMessageCommandID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("dialog", request.IdempotencyKey), CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	if mode == OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
		receipt.CanonicalMessageCommandID = DeterministicOnboardingUUID("canonical-student", request.IdempotencyKey)
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

func stepFromBlockID(blockID string) TeacherOnboardingStep {
	step, _, _, ok := onboardingBlockIdentity(blockID)
	if !ok {
		return ""
	}
	return step
}

func onboardingBlockIdentity(blockID string) (TeacherOnboardingStep, int, int64, bool) {
	for _, policyVersion := range []int{TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1, TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2} {
		for step := range map[TeacherOnboardingStep]struct{}{
			OnboardingStepDirection: {}, OnboardingStepExperience: {}, OnboardingStepKnownStack: {}, OnboardingStepDesiredStack: {},
			OnboardingStepGoal: {}, OnboardingStepLanguage: {}, OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes: {}, OnboardingStepPace: {}, OnboardingStepConfirmation: {},
		} {
			if _, known := onboardingChoicesForPolicy(step, policyVersion); !known {
				continue
			}
			prefix := "onboarding." + string(step) + ".d"
			suffix := ".v" + strconv.Itoa(policyVersion)
			if !strings.HasPrefix(blockID, prefix) || !strings.HasSuffix(blockID, suffix) {
				continue
			}
			version := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(blockID, prefix), suffix)
			parsed, err := strconv.ParseInt(version, 10, 64)
			if err == nil && parsed >= 0 && strconv.FormatInt(parsed, 10) == version {
				return step, policyVersion, parsed, true
			}
		}
	}
	return "", 0, 0, false
}
func onboardingActionHash(input AssistantUIActionRequest) (string, error) {
	value := map[string]any{"schema": input.Schema, "dialog_id": input.DialogID, "message_id": input.MessageID, "message_version": input.MessageVersion, "block_id": input.BlockID, "action_id": input.ActionID, "idempotency_key": input.IdempotencyKey}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(value))
	for key := range value {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	var builder strings.Builder
	for _, key := range keys {
		builder.WriteString(key)
		builder.WriteByte('=')
		_, _ = fmt.Fprint(&builder, value[key])
		builder.WriteByte('\n')
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(builder.String()))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}
func DeterministicOnboardingUUID(kind string, parts ...any) string {
	values := []string{"teacher-onboarding-v1", kind}
	for _, part := range parts {
		values = append(values, fmt.Sprint(part))
	}
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.MustParse("8d2595f9-1459-4f94-903c-5e94a903f196"), []byte(strings.Join(values, "\x1f"))).String()
}
func (receipt OnboardingActionReceipt) Result(replayed bool) (AssistantUIActionResultPayload, error) {
	if receipt.Status != OnboardingReceiptCompleted || receipt.ResultDraftVersion == nil || receipt.ResultProfileVersion == nil || receipt.NextMessageID == "" || !validUUID(receipt.NextMessageID) {
		return AssistantUIActionResultPayload{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	next := receipt.NextMessageID
	return AssistantUIActionResultPayload{Schema: AssistantUIActionResultSchema, Applied: true, Replayed: replayed, Status: receipt.ResultStatus, DraftVersion: *receipt.ResultDraftVersion, ProfileVersion: *receipt.ResultProfileVersion, NextMessageID: &next}, nil
}
func (receipt OnboardingActionReceipt) CanonicalResult(replayed bool) (AssistantUIActionResult, error) {
	if receipt.Status != OnboardingReceiptMaterialized || !validUUID(receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID) {
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	return AssistantUIActionResult{V2: &AssistantUIActionResultV2Payload{Schema: AssistantUIActionResultV2Schema, Mode: string(OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical), Materialized: true, Replayed: replayed, CanonicalStudentMessageID: receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID}}, nil
}
func ReceiptMatches(left, right OnboardingActionReceipt) bool {
	return left.IdempotencyKey == right.IdempotencyKey && left.RequestHash == right.RequestHash && left.StudentID == right.StudentID && left.PersonalTeacherID == right.PersonalTeacherID && left.DialogID == right.DialogID && left.SourceMessageID == right.SourceMessageID && left.SourceMessageVersion == right.SourceMessageVersion && left.BlockID == right.BlockID && left.ActionID == right.ActionID && left.Step == right.Step && left.StudentCommandID == right.StudentCommandID && left.DialogMessageCommandID == right.DialogMessageCommandID && left.ExecutionMode == right.ExecutionMode && left.CanonicalMessageCommandID == right.CanonicalMessageCommandID
}

// ReceiptReplayMatches permits an existing idempotency key to recover its
// frozen execution mode after a feature-flag change. It is never used to
// claim a different key; source/action uniqueness remains database-enforced.
func ReceiptReplayMatches(left, right OnboardingActionReceipt) bool {
	return left.IdempotencyKey == right.IdempotencyKey && left.RequestHash == right.RequestHash && left.StudentID == right.StudentID && left.PersonalTeacherID == right.PersonalTeacherID && left.DialogID == right.DialogID && left.SourceMessageID == right.SourceMessageID && left.SourceMessageVersion == right.SourceMessageVersion && left.BlockID == right.BlockID && left.ActionID == right.ActionID && left.Step == right.Step && left.StudentCommandID == right.StudentCommandID && (left.ExecutionMode == OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy || left.ExecutionMode == OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
}

// ReplayTerminalOnboardingAction returns only an exact, already terminal
// result. It lets the HTTP action endpoint preserve historical v1/v2 replay
// while the S11 cutover rejects every new or incomplete legacy execution.
func ReplayTerminalOnboardingAction(receipt OnboardingActionReceipt, request AssistantUIActionRequest, studentID string) (AssistantUIActionResult, bool, error) {
	request, err := NormalizeAssistantUIActionRequest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, err
	}
	receipt, err = NormalizeOnboardingActionReceipt(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	hash, err := onboardingActionHash(request)
	if err != nil {
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, err
	}
	if receipt.IdempotencyKey != request.IdempotencyKey || receipt.RequestHash != hash || receipt.StudentID != studentID ||
		receipt.DialogID != request.DialogID || receipt.SourceMessageID != request.MessageID || receipt.SourceMessageVersion != request.MessageVersion ||
		receipt.BlockID != request.BlockID || receipt.ActionID != request.ActionID || receipt.Step != stepFromBlockID(request.BlockID) {
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	switch receipt.Status {
	case OnboardingReceiptCompleted:
		if receipt.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy {
			return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		legacy, resultErr := receipt.Result(true)
		return LegacyAssistantUIActionResult(legacy), true, resultErr
	case OnboardingReceiptMaterialized:
		if receipt.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
			return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		result, resultErr := receipt.CanonicalResult(true)
		return result, true, resultErr
	case OnboardingReceiptRejected:
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	default:
		return AssistantUIActionResult{}, false, nil
	}
}

func NormalizeOnboardingActionReceipt(input OnboardingActionReceipt) (OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.RequestHash = strings.TrimSpace(input.RequestHash)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.SourceMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceMessageID)
	input.BlockID = strings.TrimSpace(input.BlockID)
	input.ActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionID)
	input.ClaimToken = strings.TrimSpace(input.ClaimToken)
	input.StudentCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentCommandID)
	input.DialogMessageCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogMessageCommandID)
	input.CanonicalMessageCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CanonicalMessageCommandID)
	input.CanonicalStudentMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	input.NextMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.NextMessageID)
	if !validUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || len(input.RequestHash) != 64 || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.SourceMessageID) ||
		input.SourceMessageVersion < 1 || !validOnboardingOpaqueID(input.BlockID) || !validOnboardingOpaqueID(input.ActionID) ||
		stepFromBlockID(input.BlockID) != input.Step || !validUUID(input.StudentCommandID) || !validUUID(input.DialogMessageCommandID) ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if _, err := hex.DecodeString(input.RequestHash); err != nil {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.ExecutionMode == "" {
		input.ExecutionMode = OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy
	}
	if input.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy && input.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.ExecutionMode == OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy && (input.CanonicalMessageCommandID != "" || input.CanonicalStudentMessageID != "") {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.ExecutionMode == OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical && !validUUID(input.CanonicalMessageCommandID) {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	active := input.Status == OnboardingReceiptClaimed || input.Status == OnboardingReceiptApplied
	locked := input.ClaimToken != "" && input.LockedUntil != nil
	if (input.ClaimToken == "") != (input.LockedUntil == nil) || (!active && locked) || (locked && !validUUID(input.ClaimToken)) {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if (input.ExpectedDraftVersion == nil) != (input.ExpectedProfileVersion == nil) ||
		(input.ExpectedDraftVersion != nil && (*input.ExpectedDraftVersion < 0 || *input.ExpectedProfileVersion < 0)) {
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch input.Status {
	case OnboardingReceiptClaimed:
		if input.ResultDraftVersion != nil || input.ResultProfileVersion != nil || input.ResultStatus != "" || input.NextMessageID != "" || input.CompletedAt != nil {
			return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case OnboardingReceiptApplied:
		if input.ExpectedDraftVersion == nil || input.ResultDraftVersion == nil || input.ResultProfileVersion == nil || input.NextMessageID != "" || input.CompletedAt != nil ||
			*input.ResultDraftVersion < 1 || *input.ResultProfileVersion < 0 || (input.ResultStatus != StudentOnboardingDraftDraft && input.ResultStatus != StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted) {
			return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case OnboardingReceiptCompleted:
		if input.ExpectedDraftVersion == nil || input.ResultDraftVersion == nil || input.ResultProfileVersion == nil || !validUUID(input.NextMessageID) || input.CompletedAt == nil ||
			(input.ResultStatus != StudentOnboardingDraftDraft && input.ResultStatus != StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted) {
			return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case OnboardingReceiptRejected:
		if input.ResultDraftVersion != nil || input.ResultProfileVersion != nil || input.ResultStatus != "" || input.NextMessageID != "" || input.CompletedAt != nil {
			return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case OnboardingReceiptMaterialized:
		if input.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical || !validUUID(input.CanonicalStudentMessageID) || input.ClaimToken != "" || input.LockedUntil != nil || input.ResultDraftVersion != nil || input.ResultProfileVersion != nil || input.ResultStatus != "" || input.NextMessageID != "" || input.CompletedAt == nil {
			return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return OnboardingActionReceipt{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func ValidOnboardingStepForState(draft StudentOnboardingDraft, step TeacherOnboardingStep) error {
	next, err := NextTeacherOnboardingStep(draft)
	if err != nil || next != step {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return nil
}
func FormatOnboardingVersion(value int64) string { return strconv.FormatInt(value, 10) }
func ValidOnboardingFallback(body string) bool {
	return strings.TrimSpace(body) != "" && utf8.ValidString(body) && utf8.RuneCountInString(body) <= 2000
}
